title: Serum total cholesterol and triglycerides levels in patients with lung cancer.
text_summary: 流行病学研究表明，低血清总胆固醇水平可能会增加因癌症（主要是肺癌）死亡的风险。我们研究的目的是评估鳞状细胞肺癌和小细胞肺癌患者的血清总胆固醇（TC）和甘油三酯（TG）水平及其对肿瘤组织学类型和临床分期的依赖性。肺癌患者 (n=135) 和健康对照 (n=39) 参与了研究。所有肺癌患者低胆固醇血症发生率均高于对照组，TC、TG水平低于对照组。与对照组相比，肺癌患者和两种组织学类型的 TC 浓度均较低，仅鳞状细胞肺癌患者的 TG 水平较低。组织学类型之间或各组织学类型的临床分期之间TC和TG水平没有统计学上的显着差异。

Discussion

The negative correlation between serum TC and cancer
incidence and morbidity observed in prospective epidemio­
logical studies (2-7,13) raised a question as to whether low
TC is a cause or a result of a neoplasm. Although  this
question  is not fully answered, hypocholesterolemia  is
considered rather to be an effect of a neoplasmatic process.
This theory points to several mechanisms. Many cancers are
accompanied by weight loss due to anorexia and greater
intensity of catabolic than anabolic processes. These factors
may decrease serum lipid parameters. In our study patients
